name: Portobello Stacks with Ground Pork, Pepper, Tomato & Fresh Mozzarella

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack about 6-inches from the top. Line two large baking sheet pans with aluminum foil to make clean up easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 caps portobello mushrooms
3 green bell peppers
3 tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Remove stems from the mushrooms and carefully scrape out the gills. Place on one baking sheet, rub with oil, and season with salt and pepper on both sides; arrange gill-side down.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place mushrooms in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through cooking, until tender, about 4 minutes per side. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pork and spices; cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 6-7 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1.02 kg lean ground pork
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the pork cooks, trim and discard top and bottom portions of the bell peppers, then cut each crosswise into 4 rings; remove seeds. Arrange on the second baking sheet in a single layer; drizzle with oil.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: When the mushrooms are done, place pepper rings in the oven and broil until fork-tender, about 4 minutes.
Meanwhile, slice tomatoes crosswise into rounds.

instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (227 g) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.primary_message: When the broiled peppers are ready, remove from oven. Place a bell pepper ring on top of each mushroom; fill with ground pork, then layer with tomato and mozzarella.
Place mushroom stacks in the oven and broil until cheese is melted and golden, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide mushroom stacks between plates and sprinkle with crushed red pepper; enjoy!
